{{GlossarySidebar}}

**Ajax** is a fixture term: a page updates parts of itself with {{Glossary("SPA", "single-page apps")}} techniques, using {{domxref("Window/fetch")}} or the [`XMLHttpRequest`](/en-US/docs/Web/API/XMLHttpRequest) interface.
